name: News bar
what: A news-style band: a BREAKING tag snaps in, the headline bar wipes out of it, a ticker scrolls its lines underneath, a live dot blinks; it leaves the way it came. For a funny breaking-news beat or a real update.
origin: broadcast / news packages - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: tag 8 f (slow end) + a 3 f flash; bar wipes 12 f (S-curve), headline rises 10 f; ticker drops 8 f and scrolls 5 px a frame; dot blinks every 15 f; leaves 8-10 f
